title: Ring-object bundling of the finite-subfield coefficient cocone
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a scheme. Start with the finite-subextension coefficient diagram and algebraic-closure cocone in abelian sheaves [def-sfb-qlbar-x-cocone]. Bundle its point diagram as a diagram of ring objects: the object at $E$ is $\underline E$ with its actual multiplication and unit, and each inclusion is the specified ring-object map. Bundle the point cocone with vertex $\underline\Omega$ and its specified ring-object inclusions. Define the cocone on $X$ to be its image under the ring-object functor induced by $p_X^*$ [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Thus its vertex, transitions and legs are the original coefficient objects and maps, now with their ring-object structure retained. Define also the bundled transitions and legs by pulling back the corresponding condensed-ring homomorphisms. This definition asserts no colimit property.
